meta.name: web-auth-integrator
meta.description: Integrate authentication and authorization flows with provider-specific setup and RBAC safeguards.

copy.tagline: 集成认证授权流程，配置提供商并实施RBAC保护
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中快速添加登录和权限控制
copy.tagline_en: Integrate authentication and authorization flows with provider setup and RBAC safeguards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add login and permission control to your app

howto.what: 安装并配置认证库（如 Clerk、Auth.js、Supabase Auth 或自定义 JWT），实现登录、注册、权限控制（RBAC）和 CSRF 保护，最后生成认证报告。
howto.when: 当项目需要添加用户登录、注册或权限管理功能时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个 Next.js 项目加上 Clerk 登录功能。
say.note: 自动安装 Clerk 并配置 Provider 和中间件。

say.text: 为我的项目添加自定义 JWT 认证，包括注册、登录和刷新令牌。
say.note: 生成 /auth 路由和 bcrypt 密码哈希。

howto.what_en: Installs and configures auth libraries (Clerk, Auth.js, Supabase Auth, or custom JWT), implements login, registration, RBAC, and CSRF protection, then outputs an auth report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the project needs user login, registration, or permission management.

say_en.text: Add Clerk login to this Next.js project.
say_en.note: Automatically installs Clerk and configures Provider and middleware.

say_en.text: Set up Auth.js with Google and GitHub login using JWT sessions.
say_en.note: Configures OAuth providers and JWT strategy.

say_en.text: Add custom JWT auth with registration, login, and refresh tokens.
say_en.note: Generates /auth routes and bcrypt password hashing.
